name: mybluelearning
description: Process-first learning accelerator for SAP modules and IT certifications. PWA built on 4C/ID: process maps, narrated walkthroughs, scenario drills, LLM-graded explanations and FSRS review.

scripts.check:pack: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/check-pack.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/check-pack.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/check-pack.mjs
scripts.check:quotes: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/check-quotes.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/check-quotes.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/check-quotes.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:pack && npm run check:quotes && npm run check:pipeline
scripts.check:pipeline: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/check-pipeline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/check-pipeline.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/check-pipeline.mjs
